scope: Fresh distribution userland in a privileged disposable systemd container. The host kernel is shared; this is not a separate distribution-kernel or production-container test. Image build, controller bootstrap and source compilation are outside the installation clock. Acquisition copies a source archive and prebuilt candidate; no published release download is claimed.

recipe.scope: Automated replay of the current README manual operator steps, using a prebuilt candidate. Human editing time and source compilation are excluded; this is a lower bound, not turnkey readiness. Operator commands have temporary resource limits; their wrapper overhead is included.
